text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—This is Tarumae's strength right now. 
...But seeing her run today, I can tell.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae still shows signs of growing 
further...! To a degree that's almost 
scary...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Things are getting interesting, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute-san—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...The dirt is going to sparkle even 
brighter from now on, Rickey-chan."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm gettin' fired up too!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I think this is the first time I've 
ever felt this way.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(A pleasant breeze is blowing through my 
chest... and yet, the fire inside my whole 
body is still burning—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today, I finally... was able to run a race 
with all my heart and soul.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Not bound by numbers or race results... 
Just driven by a pure desire to shine...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I feel like I can shine even 
brighter...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Upon returning, Hokko Tarumae spoke about 
a sensation she had never experienced 
before following the race...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The reason I was able to gain that feeling 
must be... because of the people who 
always support me, and Trainer. And also――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I believe it is all thanks to Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason Hokko Tarumae was able to reach 
a new stage was because Smart Falcon 
guided both her and myself there.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I— want to repay Falco-san for everything!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
After everything they've done for me, I 
haven't been able to do a single thing in 
return to this day... I feel so terribly 
sorry...!
choice_data_list: Then our next step is set.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—What Smart Falcon wanted from Hokko 
Tarumae. It had been clear ever since that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And precisely because she's Hokko Tarumae, 
there is even more she can do...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Voicing it requires determination. But 
with the Hokko Tarumae of today, we can 
surely aim straight for it...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than just aiming for Smart Falcon's 
return and competing with her, I want to 
clearly surpass the living legend that she 
is...!
choice_data_list: As a dirt Uma Musume, and as a local idol!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is the greatest way to repay Smart 
Falcon, one that only Hokko Tarumae can 
pull off."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: As a dirt Umamusume, as a local idol...—
choice_data_list: Aim for the top in both.
Aim for the top in both!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. Out of all the ways I 
could repay Falco-san, that has to be the 
very best one...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Please. Guide me to the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There, I'll surpass Falco-san... and make 
sure to repay everyone, Trainer, and 
Falco-san for everything they've done!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Once more, that is my...! That is the 
goal I must strive for!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Aiming for the summit, the blueprint for 
Hokko Tarumae's upcoming races was already 
set in my mind...!
choice_data_list: Next, let's run in the Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"The Teio Sho...! The ultimate dirt 
showdown of the first half of the 
year...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Wonder Acute, who didn't run today, 
should also be making an appearance at 
this Teio Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In this upcoming race where dirt heroes 
gather, Hokko Tarumae will loudly prove 
she's truly top-class. And using this as 
momentum—
choice_data_list:
Next, we'll aim for the top in both 
regional and Central races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Win both the Champions Cup and the Tokyo 
Daishoten, and Hokko Tarumae will prove 
she's the strongest right now—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Both the Central GⅠ Champions Cup and the 
Local GⅠ Tokyo Daishoten...!
choice_data_list:
With the way you are now, Tarumae, you can 
definitely do it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...How curious.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Before any fear or anxiety could set in, 
right now, I'm just purely excited...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I will make it happen! The roadmap to the 
top that you charted for me, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Just out of curiosity, though.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what kind of image do you 
envision for the pinnacle of locodols?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Pfft—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, haha, ahahaha! You're way too 
honest, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Then that's something we'll have to 
search for together from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later, the news arrived out of 
nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Me, in the Big Bang Idol Fest!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The "Big Bang Idol Fest." One of the 
nation's largest competitive idol 
festivals, featuring even active top 
idols.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A key feature is that both the audience 
and stream viewers cast votes on the 
performances."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The top 3 voting results will be revealed, 
and the idols chosen here will take the 
stage for the festival's grand finale 
encore...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I know super-famous local idols have 
appeared before, but to think that I would 
actually be invited...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the organizers who invited 
us, it was in recognition of her 
uniqueness as a "running local idol" and 
her recent buzz.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Talk about a godsend, huh!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The "Big Bang Idol Fest" is without a 
doubt the absolute highest peak a local 
idol can stand on...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: When will it take place!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It fits perfectly with my current race 
rotation too...! All right!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, Trainer. And let's aim for 
the number one spot in the fan vote!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When aiming for the pinnacle of locodols, 
there's no goal clearer than this!!
choice_data_list: I felt the same way too!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: As expected of my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while after gladly accepting the 
festival invitation, the management 
officially announced the participating 
idols.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
News of Hokko Tarumae's participation 
spread among her fans on social media in 
an instant, and messages of support came 
pouring in—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after Hokko Tarumae's festival 
participation was announced. While working 
in the Trainer's office, my phone rang 
with an incoming call.
choice_data_list: (This number is for the haskap farm...)

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
"—Trainer-san, thank you as always for 
your support. Actually, there's something 
I'd like to consult you about."

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Tarumae-chan, you're going to be in that 
massive idol festival coming up, right?"

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
"You've been doing so amazing in races 
lately, and working so hard on both fronts 
is super admirable! Everyone got so fired 
up and wants to cheer you on even more!"

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Could you let us discuss what we might be 
able to do for Tarumae-chan—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While aiming for the Teio Sho with Hokko 
Tarumae, another secret plan had begun to 
take shape...!
